---
title: "Headings with their text"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

Every section opens with a one-line paragraph. LaTeX keeps a heading with two
lines of its paragraph, so such a heading could sit at the foot of a page
with that line alone. Each heading must share its page with the start of its
second paragraph.
